name: Colorado River (Diamond Creek to Pearce Ferry)
gaugeName: Colorado River above Diamond Creek near Peach Springs, AZ
blurb: Lower Gorge of the Grand Canyon from Diamond Creek (Hualapai land) to Pearce Ferry in Lake Mead NRA. NPS Diamond Creek permit required.

sections.notes: NPS: 'It includes 52 river miles of smooth and white water'; noncommercial trips from Diamond Creek (river mile 225) 'take 2 to 5 days'. NPS Diamond Creek permit required; Hualapai Tribe fees to launch at Diamond Creek. Take out at Pearce Ferry or South Cove; the Pearce Ferry ramp is for river-trip take-outs only (NPS Lake Mead).
sections.mapPendingReason: Diamond Creek (Grand Canyon): Research-only grade: access-verified (official source names boating access; approximate area only). Access crosses Hualapai tribal land and the Tribe charges its own fees; the managing authority for road and landing is the Hualapai Tribe, not NPS, so this stays in the access-verified tier.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
